title: Aoyagi Toya — The Best Souvenirs!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: New York City - Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to get a chance to go sightseeing in the park...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's big, open and full of greenery, so I'm sure you'll enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you. I'm sure I will.

rows.Speaker: Elena's Voice
rows.Line:
Ceddy, hold up a sec!
There's something I wanna ask you about the park!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Okay.
Sorry, Toya, I'll be right back.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's a little hard to believe that we all performed in an event just now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We'll do a full debriefing once we get back to the hotel... But I can already say that we weren't at our best.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As a team, our English pronunciation skills still require quite a bit of work, which prevented us from really channeling our feelings. I know I was far from perfect myself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Plus, Embers and illys were both incredible.
Especially illys, when...)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Here we go, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(That song was so explosive.
I'm staggered every time I think about it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The track alone was pioneering. And yet, uncannily balanced at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The world of music is just so vast. I'm always learning new things, and I got to encounter another incredible track.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I really am grateful.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's not the only example. There was also...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Those jam sessions at the academy. That sensation, of different genres of music overcoming disparate origins and melting into one...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I could see my horizons expanding before my very eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It was different from learning from a book. Each encounter with a new sound is...special.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma's incomplete track that Tono told me about comes to mind.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It felt so free, like wind rushing through your hair. It felt wild and gentle at the same time. I felt envious of the person who wrote it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And then, I began wanting to produce those sorts of songs.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I honestly couldn't believe how well things went when we sang with Shiraishi and Azusawa for the first time in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If there was any one moment that solidified our musical style, that would be it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Then there's my first encounter with music.
My roots lie in...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That sound.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The beautiful sound that Dad played. I'll never forget it for as long as I live.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I wanted to play beautiful music like him.
I wanted to learn how to do that.
That was my first real encounter with music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And the person standing here now has been shaped by all the music which he's encountered until now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel very fortunate.
Fortunate?
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
More importantly, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Ceddy came to get you, and I followed him!
We came to tell you that we've decided where we're going.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But we heard you saying how you're very fortunate. Something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, not exactly...
I was just thinking about some things....

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: What things?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
As the songwriter for Vivid BAD SQUAD, I gained quite a lot from hearing the track you made, Elena.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Wait, mine?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I said this when we were all sharing our opinions, but I thought it was very good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only was it a difficult song, you two blew everyone away by performing it flawlessly. Your power shook all of us to our cores.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
I agree.
I learned a lot from how bold you were too, Elena.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
Keep the praise coming!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Don't get too ahead of yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It all got me thinking about the world of music, and how vast it really is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Be it Vivid Street or the United States, I've been able to encounter music which I'd never even imagined before in my life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Wonderful songs which moved my heart,
songs full of sounds I've never heard before that enrich me as a person...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Both things have had a positive impact on me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thus, I feel very fortunate about having been able to make all those musical encounters.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've been lucky to meet so many people, and learn from and be influenced by them. Thanks to them, my compositional skills have improved.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That being said, the world of music is vast, and I'm still yet to reach the heart of it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My music still has much room to grow.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I'm impressed you're able to talk like this after hearing such an unbelievable song.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Also...
I think there's more to this story than just luck.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's no accident that you have a sharp eye and keen perception for these things, Toya. You worked hard to achieve that, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's also true...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: As your opponent, I can't afford to let my guard down, huh?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Haha. No, you can't!
Let's have ourselves a good battle, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Embers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we don't plan on losing.
